name: io.github.moldkey/oracleluck
title: OracleLuck 天啟好運
description: Chinese metaphysics toolkit: daily almanac (黃曆), four-pillar BaZi charts, I Ching hexagrams, 78 tarot cards, and full-text search over a 3,100-page knowledge base. All data is computed by deterministic engines — 1,096 precomputed days of calendar, all 64 hexagrams, all 78 tarot cards.
